stem: For A(−3, 2), plot the point Q symmetric to A with respect to the $y$-axis.
solution: Symmetric about the y-axis: change the sign of the x-coordinate.

hints.text: Reflecting in the y-axis changes only one coordinate's sign; the other stays.
The first number is across (x), the second is up (y).
Reflection keeps the distances from the axes; only a sign changes.
